title: Derivation and Validation of a Combination of BOSTON Score and DES-OSA Score for Selection of OSA Patients.
brief_summary: Derivation and Validation of a combination of BOSTON score and DES-OSA score to exclude OSA or to confirm OSA in patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients admitted in the Clinique Saint-Luc of Bouge for a polysomnography

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient's refusal
study_population: Population to validate the cutoff of the combination of scores
